claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says the Federation-sponsored First Contact project ran from about 2008 to 2016, involving Alfratean, Antarian, and Taygetan participants, with Taygetans leading.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She notes some participants date the project’s end to 2017.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says First Contact volunteers used Toleka computer decks to enter human social media, while a Federation server system monitored and censored orbital communications.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: They communicated by text under First Directive restrictions.
